Definition: to take the right hand road
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the word behind you on the road: thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left. The word is to take the right hand road, the turn to the right, and the voice tells you which way to turn.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the right hand road carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the voice with it, that God does not leave His people to guess the way but speaks behind them as they walk.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
